data.name: Aabad
data.gender_notes: Aabad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian ābād (آباد), 'inhabited, cultivated, prosperous', from āb (آب), 'water'. It is NOT related to the Arabic ʿabd (عبد), 'servant' — that is the separate name ʿĀbid/ʿAbid. Its root is Persian ābād (آباد). A Persian/Urdu toponymic and personal name element (e.g. Islāmābād, Ḥaydarābād). Aabad is a Persian name meaning “Inhabited; cultivated; prosperous; flourishing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabad expresses “Inhabited; cultivated; prosperous; flourishing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Persian ābād (آباد), 'inhabited, cultivated, prosperous', from āb (آب), 'water'. It is NOT related to the Arabic ʿabd (عبد), 'servant' — that is the separate name ʿĀbid/ʿAbid.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabad total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
